Title: Users may be unable to view previously deleted teams after restoration in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users may be unable to view previously deleted teams after restoration in Microsoft Teams.

More info: As a workaround, changing an affected user's role (member to owner and then back to member) makes the team visible for that user.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to view previously deleted teams after restoration in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users may be unable to view previously deleted teams after restoration in Microsoft Teams.

More info: As a workaround, changing an affected user's role (member to owner and then back to member) makes the team visible for that user.

Current status: We’re reviewing screenshots of impact and client logs captured from an affected user to assist our investigation into the source of the issue. In parallel, we’ve successfully reproduced impact in our internal testing environment and are reviewing this reproduction to further assist our root cause efforts. 

Scope of impact: This issue may affect any user attempting to view previously deleted and restored teams. 

Next update by: Monday, November 9, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to view previously deleted teams after restoration in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users may be unable to view previously deleted teams after restoration in Microsoft Teams.

More info: As a workaround, changing an affected user's role (member to owner and then back to member) makes the team visible for that user.

Current status: We’ve identified a recent change introduced a regression that resulted in restored teams remaining invisible due to a code check missing the “restored” tag, resulting in impact. We’re developing a fix to correct this issue and working to establish a timeline for the fix deployment. 

Scope of impact: This issue may affect any user attempting to view previously deleted and restored teams. 

Root cause: A recent change introduced a regression that resulted in restored teams remaining invisible due to a code check missing the “restored” tag, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Monday, November 9, 2026, at 7:30 PM UTC
